info.desc: Bella Donna is the debut solo studio album by American singer and songwriter Stevie Nicks. Released on July 27, 1981, the album reached number one on the US Billboard 200 in September of that year. Bella Donna was awarded platinum status by the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA) on October 7, 1981, less than three months after its release, and in 1990 was certified quadruple-platinum for four million copies shipped. Bella Donna spent nearly three years on the Billboard 200 from July 1981 to June 1984. .

podcast.body: Stevie Nicks' solo debut album topped the Billboard album chart in 1981, released during a period when Fleetwood Mac members were pursuing individual projects following the "Tusk" tour. "Stevie Nicks, who topped the Billboard album chart with her solo debut, Bella Donna."
